mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_legacy_application_extra_answer ( research_no, research_app_seq, answer_order, question_group, question_label, answer_text, raw_answer_text, created_at ) VALUES ( #{researchNo}, #{researchAppSeq}, #{answerOrder}, #{questionGroup}, #{questionLabel}, #{answerText}, #{rawAnswerText}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_legacy_application_extra_answer WHERE research_no = #{researchNo} ORDER BY research_app_seq ASC, answer_order ASC, id ASC
